prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Iván, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Iván thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "It’s finally happening: the council is launching an aggressive crackdown and will be slapping massive fines on anyone who dares leave a bin out after 8am. They are clearly done playing around, so expect strict enforcement starting next month."
text: The council is officially declaring war on our sidewalks and will be seizing bins and issuing crippling fines for any leftovers. They’re finally cracking down with zero tolerance, so expect total enforcement and massive penalties starting immediately.
